nids_sensor_coverage_at_chokepoints.title: NIDS Sensor Coverage at Chokepoints
nids_sensor_coverage_at_chokepoints.description: Network IDS sensors are deployed at all major ingress/egress and inter-zone chokepoints and are actively analyzing traffic. Secure value: true.

hids_on_critical_hosts.title: Host IDS on Critical Hosts
hids_on_critical_hosts.description: Host-based IDS sensors run on critical hosts. Secure value: true.

detection_rules_present_and_enabled.title: Detection Rules Present and Enabled
detection_rules_present_and_enabled.description: Detection rulesets are loaded with the relevant categories enabled. Secure value: true.

threat_signatures_current.title: Threat Signatures Current
threat_signatures_current.description: Signature/content feeds are updated automatically and frequently (at least daily). Secure value: true.

behavior_monitoring_enabled.title: Behavioral Detection Enabled
behavior_monitoring_enabled.description: Anomaly/behavioral detection runs alongside signature detection. Secure value: true.

network_flow_logging_enabled.title: Network Flow Logging Enabled
network_flow_logging_enabled.description: Network flow telemetry (NetFlow/IPFIX) feeds anomaly detection and threat hunting. Secure value: true.

tls_inspection_enabled.title: Encrypted-Traffic Visibility (TLS Inspection)
tls_inspection_enabled.description: TLS inspection at a chokepoint, or host-sensor cleartext visibility, closes the encrypted blind spot. Secure value: true.

centralized_log_aggregation.title: Centralized Log Aggregation
centralized_log_aggregation.description: IDS alerts and logs are forwarded to a centralized, monitored SIEM. Secure value: true.

monitored_response_function_present.title: Monitored Response Function Present
monitored_response_function_present.description: A monitored SOC/MDR function triages IDS alerts under defined response SLAs. Secure value: true.

clocks_synced_to_trusted_time_source.title: Clocks Synced to Trusted Time Source
clocks_synced_to_trusted_time_source.description: Sensor clocks are NTP-synced to a trusted source so multi-sensor timestamps correlate. Secure value: true.

ids_detection_tuned_and_reviewed.title: Detection Tuned and Reviewed
ids_detection_tuned_and_reviewed.description: IDS is tuned per-environment with documented suppression rationale and periodic alert-quality review. Secure value: true.

ids_sensor_hardened_and_patched.title: Sensor Hardened and Patched
ids_sensor_hardened_and_patched.description: The IDPS itself is hardened (restricted management access, patched). Secure value: true.

ids_sensor_fail_mode_defined.title: Sensor Fail-Mode Defined
ids_sensor_fail_mode_defined.description: A deliberate fail-open/fail-closed decision is made for inline deployments. Secure value: true.

ids_sensor_health_monitored.title: Sensor Health Monitored
ids_sensor_health_monitored.description: Sensor health/heartbeat is monitored so a dead or degraded sensor is noticed. Secure value: true.
